newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SETS UP U.S. TELEPHONY UNIT.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SETS UP U.S. TELEPHONY UNIT.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it had set up a new group in the U.S. for the development and marketing of telephony products in North and South America.

The group, called Philips Consumer Communications - Americas, will be based in Dallas, Texas, and will market personal communications products. These include digital and analog cellular and cordless phones, corded phones, answering machines, screen phones, pagers and SIM cards.
The new unit will have a production facility in Fremont.
Philips said it aims at becoming one of the top three manufacturers of consumer communications equipment by the year 2000.
